summary: Planned Sprint 2 into architecture, data, API, UI, QA, and security workstreams for standard-library JWT authentication.

new_tasks.title: Define the standard-library authentication design: user model, password hashing, signed JWT claims/expiry, API contract, and task ownership rules.
Add a users schema and migrate task ownership in database.py, including unique usernames and secure password-hash storage fields.
Implement register/login endpoints, standard-library JWT signing and verification, and Bearer-token protection plus per-user scoping for task endpoints in server.py.
Add register/login UI and authenticated task requests in static/index.html, retaining a token only for the browser session and handling unauthenticated responses.
Add regression coverage for registration, login, token expiry/invalid-token rejection, protected task endpoints, and task isolation between users.
Review password hashing, JWT signing/verification, token handling, authorization boundaries, and auth error responses after implementation.

messages.content: Define a dependency-free authentication contract suitable for Python standard library only; include exact JWT claims and expiry behavior.
Wait for the authentication design, then own only the user and task-ownership schema/migration work.
Implement authentication only after the architecture and database contracts are ready; do not add external dependencies.
Implement the auth interface after backend contract completion; use session-scoped rather than persistent browser token storage.
Prepare auth, authorization-isolation, and invalid-token regression coverage once the API and UI land.
Review the final authentication implementation, especially password storage and every protected task route.

decisions: Sprint 2 must use only Python standard-library capabilities; JWT support will therefore need an explicitly designed HMAC-based implementation rather than a third-party JWT package.
Task access must be scoped to the authenticated user, not merely guarded by the presence of a token.
